audio.t: Good afternoon, everyone. Since many of you will move out of the dorms next semester, I'd like to share a few tips about renting off campus. First, never transfer money before you've seen the place in person and met the landlord. Every year, several students lose their deposits to fake online listings with photos that look too good to be true.

Second, read the contract carefully. In Taiwan, the security deposit can't be more than two months' rent, and the lease should clearly say who pays for utilities and repairs. If the landlord charges for electricity at a much higher rate than the power company does, ask about it before you sign. Also, take photos of every room on move-in day. These photos can protect you when you move out and want your deposit back.

Finally, think about safety. Check that the building has working smoke detectors and that the gas water heater is not installed indoors without proper ventilation. Our office keeps a list of rentals that have passed a safety inspection, and you're welcome to drop by and look at it anytime.

questions.explain: 開頭說 many of you will move out of the dorms next semester，聽眾是即將搬離宿舍的學生（A）。內容是給租屋者的建議，不是對房東或員工說話。

head: From: Daniel Chen <dchen.rentals@mail.com>
To: Tenants of Building B, Lane 32
Subject: Water Heater Replacement and Rent Reminder
passage: I'm writing to let you know that the old gas water heaters in Building B will be replaced with electric ones next Tuesday, December 1. A technician will need to enter each unit between 9 a.m. and noon. If you will not be home, please let me know by Sunday so that I can arrange for the building manager to let the technician in. Hot water will not be available while the work is being done.

This change was made after the fire department's inspection last month. Although the new heaters will cost a little more to run, they are much safer, and I have decided not to pass the extra cost on to you this school year.
Also, a reminder that December rent is due on the fifth. Please transfer the payment to the same account as before and send me a screenshot.

questions.explain: 第二段說更換是在消防局檢查之後，且新熱水器 much safer，可知是安全考量（C）。信中說新的反而較耗費用（B 錯），沒提到房客抱怨或電力公司。
options: Tenants complained about cold water.
The old heaters cost too much to run.
An inspection raised safety concerns.
The power company required it.

questions.explain: 信中寫 If you will not be home, please let me know by Sunday（D），房東會請管理員開門，所以不用留門（A 錯）；沒有改時間或預付費用的說法。

passage: As the fall semester nears its end, many students at Kaiyuan University are already searching for apartments for next year. This year, however, the hunt has become more stressful. According to a survey by the Student Association, the average monthly rent for a single room within walking distance of campus has risen to about NT$8,500, up nearly 15 percent from two years ago.

The survey, which collected responses from more than 1,200 students, found that one in three now lives more than five kilometers from campus. "I used to walk to class in ten minutes," said junior Kevin Huang. "Now I ride my scooter for half an hour each way." Several students also reported taking extra part-time jobs to cover housing costs, which they said left them less time for studying.

Students point to several causes. New MRT construction near the campus has attracted young professionals who are willing to pay higher rents, and some landlords have turned student rooms into short-term rentals for tourists. At the same time, the university's dormitories can house only about 40 percent of undergraduates, and freshmen and international students are given priority.

The university says it is responding. A new dormitory with 600 beds is scheduled to open in fall 2028, and the Office of Student Affairs has launched a rent subsidy program for students from low-income families. The office has also partnered with the city government to inspect off-campus rentals and publish a list of safe, fairly priced options. Still, Student Association president Grace Lo believes more can be done. "A building three years away doesn't help students who need a room this spring," she said. The association plans to meet with school officials next month to propose a temporary housing plan.

questions.explain: 全文談房租上漲使學生住得更遠、原因，以及校方的因應，A 涵蓋主旨。MRT 只是原因之一（C 過窄），室友與選舉未提及。
options: Why students are living farther from campus and how the school is responding
How students can find good roommates
The opening of a new MRT line
The results of a Student Association election
